curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: count Kenyan currency coins one at a time

mission.title: count Kenyan currency coins one at a time

interactions.prompt: Touch each sh.1 coin once. How many coins are there?
interactions.feedback: Yes! You counted 3 coins, one at a time.
interactions.retryHint: Point to one coin, say 1, then point to the next coin.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion count the sh.5 coins. Tap every coin once, from left to right.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each coin once instead of dragging a counter to it.
interactions.feedback: Good counting! There are 4 sh.5 coins.
interactions.retryHint: Start with the first coin. Give each coin just one tap as you count.

interactions.prompt: Count the sh.10 coins one at a time. Which number tells how many coins?
interactions.feedback: Well done! You counted 5 sh.10 coins.
interactions.retryHint: Keep your finger on a coin after you count it, so you do not count it twice.

interactions.prompt: Count the sh.20 coins in the tray. Tap each coin once, then choose how many you counted.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each coin once; then tap the number you counted.
interactions.retryHint: Move across the tray in one direction. Count every coin once.

interactions.prompt: At the classroom shop, tap only the sh.40 coins. How many did you tap?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each sh.40 coin once, then tap the number.
interactions.feedback: Great work! You found and counted 4 sh.40 coins.
interactions.retryHint: Look for coins that match the sh.40 coin. Count only those coins.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Count these sh.1 coins one at a time. How many are there?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap every coin once, then choose the number.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You counted 8 Kenyan coins one at a time.
interactions.retryHint: Start at one end. Touch and count each coin only once.
